tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of the console and marketing pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, menus and the SMS preview phone; sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside cards: code, filter bars, the queue tray.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and select borders: 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and green-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, table headers; 4.5:1 on every surface and on green-soft.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Revisit Green. The one primary action per view, positive outcomes (booked, recovered), the focus ring, chart main series. As text, on surfaces and green-soft.

tokens.name: green-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of green fills; links and green text that needs extra weight.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind green text: the Booked and Sent pills, the selected queue row, the chart area fill.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green or green-strong fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Needs-attention fills only: the Due dot, the sync-stale banner stripe, a highlighted chart point. Never error.

tokens.name: marigold-ink
tokens.usage: Attention text (Due, Paused, Sync is stale) on marigold-soft and on the surfaces.

tokens.name: marigold-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind marigold-ink: Due and Paused pills, the sync warning banner.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text on a marigold fill.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Failed and destructive only: a failed send, Delete, a blocked text. As text, on surfaces and coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind coral text: the Failed pill, the blocked-content callout.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Comparison series in charts (last month, clinic average). Marks only, never body text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring 2px outside the control. Alias of green, at least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in body copy, on the surfaces.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The one money number on a screen: bookings recovered this month. Tabular figures.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing page heroes and the empty-state headline. Never inside the console's working views.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One page title per console view.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ana Cruz is due for her 6-month check-up.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Patient names, row titles, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, pill text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, chart axis labels.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Phone numbers, SMS segment counters, IDs. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; queue row inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; form field gaps; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Queue row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gutter between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a view.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page-level bands on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small chips, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the SMS bubble, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised buttons and the sticky table header. Cards use a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the approve-all confirm sheet. Floating things only.
